title: Part-payment, prepayment and foreclosure - support procedure
content: For the fictional bank, a verified demo agent reviews the configured outstanding amount and applicable early-settlement policy. Obtain the authorized settlement quote before acting; the assistant does not promise that an extra payment automatically closes a real loan.
